billingUsage.title: Usage & Cost Guard
billingUsage.intro: Billable events of the current period, a forecast to the period end, overage in event packs, unusual load against the 4-week baseline and your explicit choice of what happens at the limit. Every figure comes from the usage ledger and the period counters; nothing is estimated silently.

alerts.hardLimitTitle: Limit reached — processing flagged for pause
alerts.hardLimitText: The usage check flagged this period on {at} under the policy “{policy}”. Change the policy below or switch plan on the overview; the flag is re-evaluated as soon as you save.
alerts.softLimitAllow: Events above the limit are billed as event packs because overage is allowed.
alerts.softLimitCostLimit: Events above the limit are billed as event packs up to your monthly cost limit of {limit}; processing pauses beyond {pauseAt} events.
alerts.softLimitPause: Processing pauses at {pauseAt} events ({grace} % grace above the limit) unless you allow overage or switch plan.
alerts.staleTitle: Period counters are behind the ledger
alerts.staleText: The ledger holds events newer than the last counter update ({updated}). The counters catch up with the next ingestion run; the daily chart already includes the newer events.
alerts.ledgerOnlyText: The period counters have not been written yet, so the billable figure is the sum of this period's ledger rows.
alerts.noLimitTitle: No fixed event cap in this plan
alerts.noLimitText: Overage, thresholds and the pause option do not apply; volume is agreed in your contract.

empty.title: No billable events in this period yet
empty.text: The usage ledger has no rows for {period}. Events appear here once the ingestion accepts them; test-mode events, duplicates and retries never count.

forecast.label: Forecast at period end
forecast.noBasis: No ledger rows in the last 7 days — equals today's count

overage.label: Overage now
overage.contractual: Contractual — no pack for this plan

load.label: Load vs. 4-week baseline
load.noBaseline: No baseline yet — {from} – {to} holds no events

meter.title: Limit and warning thresholds
meter.intro: Billable events of this period against the plan's monthly limit. Warnings are stamped by the usage check at 70, 90 and 100 %; the expected dates come from the 7-day forecast.

thresholds.title: Warning thresholds
thresholds.reachedPending: Reached — the alert is stamped on the next usage check
thresholds.notExpected: Not expected this period · {remaining} to go

meter.pauseAt: Processing pauses at {events} events ({pct} of the limit).
meter.neverPauses: Processing never pauses under the current policy; overage is billed as event packs.

chart.title: Billable events per day
chart.intro: UTC days from {from} to {to}: the 4-week baseline, the 7 complete days the forecast is averaged over, and today so far. The forecast is a projection and is not drawn.
chart.aria: Bar chart of billable events over {days} days: {recent} in the last 7 complete days, {baseline} in the 4-week baseline before them, {today} today so far.
chart.empty: No billable events in this window.

policy.title: What happens at the limit
policy.intro: Overage is never activated on its own. You choose whether additional events are billed as packs, capped by a monthly cost limit, or whether processing pauses after the grace window. The usage check applies your choice on every run and every change is audited.
policy.readOnly: Your role can view the policy but not change it.

allow.label: Allow overage
allow.description: Events above the limit are billed as event packs at list price. Processing never pauses.

cost_limit.label: Monthly cost limit
cost_limit.description: Event packs are billed up to the amount you set; once the packs needed would cost more, processing pauses for the rest of the period.

pause.label: Pause at the limit
pause.description: Processing continues through a grace window above the limit, then pauses for the rest of the period. No pack is ever billed.

notes.cost_limit_unset: No amount set — behaves like “Pause at the limit”.
notes.no_pack: No pack for this plan — behaves like “Pause at the limit”.

costLimit.label: Monthly cost limit (whole euros)
costLimit.hint: {packs} packs of {events} events at {price} each fit in this limit.
costLimit.noPack: This plan has no event pack; a cost limit cannot buy overage.
costLimit.invalid: Enter a whole amount between {min} and {max}.

consequence.allow: Every {events} events above the limit are billed as one pack of {price}, without an upper bound.
consequence.costLimit: Up to {limit} per month pays for {packs} packs ({events} events above the limit). Processing pauses beyond {pauseAt} billable events.
consequence.costLimitUnset: Enter an amount to see how many packs it pays for.
consequence.pause: Processing pauses at {pauseAt} billable events ({grace} % above the limit). No pack is billed.
consequence.noLimit: This plan has no fixed event cap, so the policy has no effect until a capped plan applies.
consequence.noPack: This plan has no event pack, so overage cannot be bought; processing pauses after the grace window.

confirm.title: Confirm the overage policy
confirm.text: The policy applies to the current period at once: the pause flag is re-evaluated when you save, and the usage check applies the same rule on every run.
confirm.acknowledge: I understand that events above the limit will be billed as event packs at list price.

policy.savedPaused: Policy saved. Under this policy the current period is flagged as paused.
policy.savedNotPaused: Policy saved. The current period is not paused.

errors.invalid: The choice could not be saved: check the cost limit.
errors.forbidden: Your role cannot change the billing policy.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Nothing was changed.

comparison.title: Event pack or next plan?
comparison.intro: For the forecast of {events} billable events per month, at catalogue list prices per {period}.
comparison.introNoBasis: For {events} billable events per month (today's count — no 7-day rate yet), at catalogue list prices per {period}.
comparison.stay: Staying on {plan} with event packs is the cheaper option for this volume.
comparison.upgradeHint: {plan} would cost {savings} less per {period} for this volume.
comparison.noneCheapest: No option can be priced for this volume from the catalogue.
comparison.noSilent: Track never switches your plan or buys packs on its own.
comparison.contractualNote: This plan has no list price; overage is agreed in your contract.
comparison.taxNote: List prices excluding VAT; the amount on your invoice comes from Stripe.

sites.title: Billable events per site
sites.intro: Ledger rows of this period by site. Usage is measured per organization; the active site is highlighted.
sites.empty: No ledger rows for this period.

rules.title: What counts as a billable event
rules.intro: An event is counted exactly once when the ingestion accepts it; forwarding it to several destinations never increases usage. Never counted:

guard.text: Forecast, overage, unusual load and your choice of what happens at the limit.
guard.noLimit: No fixed event cap in this plan
